gaps: M1 Garand distant shot and outdoor tail: no CC0/CC-BY Garand recorded at distance. Fallback: the FFSL .30-06 bolt-action mid-distance file (snd-ffsl-3006-bolt, same cartridge) for the tail and distant layer, low-passed around 2.5 kHz with 100-300 ms pre-delay under the real Garand close shot.
M1911 distant shot: only close (areniporgen) and FFSL mid-distance exist. Fallback: FFSL 1911 mid-distance file A_34P.wav plus distance filtering (low-pass, early-reflection convolution).

MP5 live-fire close shot: the only real MP5 recordings under CC0 fire blanks (Franki-01234). Fallback: layer the MP5 blanks for character with the FFSL Carl Gustav M45 9 mm single shot for body. The CC-BY 'MP5 Shoot' set by smill.and.welson was rejected because it is lifted from someone else's YouTube video.

MP5 reload: only airsoft-replica magazine sounds (Sadiquecat). No real MP5 mag or charging-handle 'HK slap'. Fallback: pitch the airsoft mag sounds down ~2 semitones and use a slice of snd-ar15-various for the bolt slap.

M249 reload (feed-tray cover, belt, charging handle): nothing verified. snd-mg-reload is an unspecified machine gun. Fallback: build from snd-garand-handling metal clacks + ammo-can/metal lid foley + snd-ar15-various charging handle.
M249 dry fire and dedicated M249 distant/tail: use snd-gun-click-1 for dry fire; for distance use the Baelphazoar range takes (already mid-distance) and snd-mg-distant.
Remington 870 distant shot: use the FFSL pump 12 gauge mid-distance files and snd-shotgun-shot-echo.

Supersonic crack variety: a single 80 ms real fly-by exists (snd-bullet-crack). Fallback: pitch/gain randomisation, plus a synthesized layer (1-2 ms noise burst through a 2-6 kHz band-pass, followed by a short doppler-swept noise whoosh).

Bullet impacts on concrete, wood, metal and dirt recorded from real bullets: not found under CC0/CC-BY. Items listed are foley stand-ins (metal on rock, rocks on wood/dirt, hits on metal). Layer each with a short filtered noise burst and a debris tail.
Shell casings on dirt/forest floor: none. Fallback: casings-on-stones (CC-BY) or concrete takes, low-passed at ~3 kHz, shortened to the first bounce and mixed 10-12 dB down.
Cobblestone run and CC0 cobblestone walk: only the CC-BY Yle walk. Fallback: concrete singles and run sequence with a touch of the stone-boots set.

Lossless sources: Freesound originals (WAV/FLAC) need a logged-in session; the URLs here are the public HQ MP3 previews (lossy, ~128 kbps). If higher fidelity is wanted, log in once and pull the originals from the same source_page; licences are identical.

Sources not covered: Pixabay was never tried. Kenney's impact-sound pack is CC0 but its zip URL is not in the page HTML, so no direct link. Wikimedia Commons was searched for ten gun terms and returned nothing usable; the seven Commons queries for ricochets, footsteps and ambience errored and were not retried.
notes: WHAT 'verified' MEANS: every download_url answered a plain ranged GET with 200/206, an audio or archive content type and the size recorded. No file was listened to. Descriptions such as real, close, clean or exterior are taken from the uploader's title and description, and for most Freesound items the licence was read from the CC0-filtered (or Attribution-filtered) search listing; about 70 sound pages were opened individually, including every CC-BY item. Audition before shipping. OPEN LICENCE QUESTION: the qubodup items (M4A1 variations, M2010/M40A6/M110 sniper shots, bullet crack, distant gunfire, R870 pump clicks, gun click) are tagged CC0 but are cut from US military DVIDS video, and his descriptions say 'See profile for CC BY attribution requirements'. That profile was not read, and the weapon identifications are his own guesses. Read it or credit him and DVIDS before use. FREESOUND: full-quality downloads need login; the HQ preview at https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/<id/1000>/<id>_<uploaderId>-hq.mp3 is an unauthenticated GET (a -hq.ogg twin exists). These are lossy previews. MP3 was picked for the WKWebView build on the assumption that Ogg support there is unreliable, which was not tested. Sibling ids in notes share the uploader id, so their URLs follow the same pattern but were not fetched. FREE FIREARM SOUND LIBRARY (OpenGameArt, CC0; the page lists Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras and Matthew Nanney as recordists and says credit is optional): one 194 MB 7z, downloaded in full. The inner paths come from its file list and master sheet, which labels each weapon with a near and a mid-distance 'gunshot' take. Three files were opened (AR-15 near and mid, 1911 near): 24-bit/96 kHz stereo, 6.5 to 10.2 s. That each file is a single shot with a usable tail is inferred from the sheet and those durations, not heard. Its Mossberg folder is a bolt-action shotgun, so the Benelli Nova and Winchester Model 12 pump guns are mapped to the 870. REJECTED on their own descriptions: db465 1911/MP5/M249 shots, morganpurkis distant gunshots and loudernoises heartbeat (synthesized); Audionautics passbys and the CGEffex, Joao_Janz and aust_paul ricochets (designed); smill.and.welson MP5 and AR sets (lifted from third-party YouTube videos). 26 further sibling variations that also passed the GET check were left out to keep the list short. Many files hold several takes and need slicing. Search scripts and raw results: /private/tmp/claude-503/-Users-neel-Documents-GitHub/d086b07b-d24d-40ea-87af-7e9cfbff44cb/scratchpad/snd
